description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Code' which represents a parse tree node for a code fragment within the Smarty template engine's compiler subsystem. It extends 'Smarty_Internal_ParseTree' and provides methods for constructing the node with data and converting it into a PHP code fragment for Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Code
classes.description: Represents a parse tree node for a code fragment within Smarty templates, providing functionality to encapsulate template code snippets and render them as PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parse tree node with a code fragment data.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Returns the code fragment wrapped in parentheses, formatted as a PHP string for compilation.
